root_folder.label: Root Folder
root_folder.help_text: Root folder used by the FileManage tools.

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Shared: scan the root folder only, or include every nested folder too.

workflow.label: Workflow
workflow.help_text: Choose the active Rename flow. The form below will switch to the fields used by that workflow.

text_action.label: Text Action
text_action.help_text: Text Transform only: choose whether to replace, add, or remove text.

search_text.label: Search Text
search_text.help_text: Text Transform only: the text to find inside each matching filename.
search_text.placeholder: Text to search in file names

replace_text.label: Replace Text
replace_text.help_text: Text Transform only: what should replace the matched text.

added_text.label: Added Text
added_text.help_text: Text Transform only: the text added as a prefix or suffix. Leave this blank when Per Folder Alphabet Mode should add a, b, c... per folder instead.

match_scope.label: Match Scope
match_scope.help_text: Text Transform only: change the filename only, or include the extension as well.

match_occurrence.label: Match Occurrence
match_occurrence.help_text: Text Transform only: apply the change to all, the first, or the last match.

per_folder_alpha_mode.label: Per Folder Alphabet Mode
per_folder_alpha_mode.help_text: Text Transform only: for Replace, Add Prefix, or Add Suffix, ignore the replacement or added text and assign a, b, c... per folder in sorted order.

trim_delimiter.label: Delimiter
trim_delimiter.help_text: Trim by Delimiter only: the delimiter used as the cut point, such as _, -, (, or [.

trim_action.label: Trim Action
trim_action.help_text: Trim by Delimiter only: choose which side of the delimiter should remain or be removed.

delimiter_occurrence.label: Delimiter Occurrence
delimiter_occurrence.help_text: Trim by Delimiter only: use the first or last matching delimiter in the filename.

include_delimiter.label: Keep Delimiter
include_delimiter.help_text: Trim by Delimiter only: keep the delimiter in the remaining filename when enabled.

order_ascending.label: Order Ascending
order_ascending.help_text: Shared: controls folder and file order for alphabet mode and numbering.

start_letter.label: Start Letter
start_letter.help_text: Text Transform only: first letter used when per-folder alphabet mode is enabled for Replace, Add Prefix, or Add Suffix.

number_action.label: Number Action
number_action.help_text: Numbering only: swap existing numbers, add a numbered prefix or suffix, or replace the whole filename with the sequence.

start_number.label: Start Number
start_number.help_text: Numbering only: the first number used for sequence-based actions.

increment.label: Increment
increment.help_text: Numbering only: how much the sequence increases each step.

number_width.label: Number Width
number_width.help_text: Numbering only: digits to use, for example 2 for 01 or 3 for 001.

number_separator.label: Number Separator
number_separator.help_text: Numbering only: text placed between the sequence and the filename.

reset_per_folder.label: Reset Per Folder
reset_per_folder.help_text: Numbering only: restart sequence numbers inside each folder.

target_extensions.label: Target Extensions
target_extensions.help_text: Shared: comma-separated extensions to include, such as .png,.jpg. Leave blank to scan every file type.

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Scan the workspace recursively when enabled.

old_extension.label: Source Extension
old_extension.help_text: Choose .all to include every supported image type, or limit the run to one source extension.

new_extension.label: Target Extension
new_extension.help_text: Choose the extension that converted image files should be saved with.

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Scan the workspace recursively for ZIP files when enabled.

delete_archives_after_extract.label: Delete Archives After Extract
delete_archives_after_extract.help_text: Permanently delete the source ZIP files after a successful extraction.

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Gather images from all subfolders within the workspace to include in the PDF.

delete_source_images.label: Delete Source Images
delete_source_images.help_text: Delete the original image files once the PDF creation is complete.

fit_to_largest.label: Fit To Largest Page
fit_to_largest.help_text: Resizes every page in the PDF to match the dimensions of the largest image.

upscale_method.label: Upscale Method
upscale_method.help_text: Choose how to handle images smaller than the page (scale up or add padding).

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Scan the workspace recursively for PDF files to convert into images.

delete_source_pdfs.label: Delete Source PDFs
delete_source_pdfs.help_text: Delete the source PDF files after they have been successfully converted.

image_format.label: Image Format
image_format.help_text: Select the desired image output format (JPG or PNG).

jpeg_quality.label: JPEG Quality
jpeg_quality.help_text: Set the JPEG quality (1-100). Higher values produce clearer images but larger files.

output_root.label: Output Root
output_root.help_text: Destination root for converted MP4 files. The folder structure from the workspace is mirrored here.

include_subfolders.label: Include Subfolders
include_subfolders.help_text: Scan the workspace recursively for .webp files when enabled.

overwrite_existing.label: Overwrite Existing Files
overwrite_existing.help_text: Replace existing MP4 files in the output root instead of skipping them.

crf.label: CRF
crf.help_text: Lower CRF means higher output quality and larger file sizes. 18 is the original script default.

preset.label: Preset
preset.help_text: FFmpeg encoding speed preset used by libx264 during conversion.

order_ascending.label: Order Ascending
order_ascending.help_text: Controls the order used when the recursive JPG fix scans matching files.
